description:
Outcome: A gardener applies for the coming season with up to three preferred plots, from brief.md / First version must 1.
Scope: Open-season application form, zero to three distinct valid preferences, one application per household-season, server-recorded application timestamp and deterministic tie sequence, previous-season eligibility indication. Excludes: self-service post-submission amendment or cancellation.
Acceptance: Persist the application and show confirmation; duplicate submissions return the existing application without changing original order; reject invalid or duplicate preferences; cutoff eligibility is computed in the configured local timezone.
Behaviour: Accessible phone form explains no-open-season, validation, loading, failure and retry states without losing entered data.
Verification: UI and integration tests covering 0–3 preferences, invalid choices, duplicate requests and February 1 boundary. Prerequisites: T-002 and T-004. Assumptions: zero preferences is valid; preferences are requests, not guarantees; no first-version amendment workflow.
title: Season applications
